description: Na₄Mg(CoO₃)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (2.31 Å) and two longer (2.34 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to six O atoms. There are four shorter (2.27 Å) and two longer (2.93 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted octahedral geometry to six O atoms. There are two shorter (2.35 Å) and four longer (2.74 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Mg is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Mg-O bond lengths are 2.05 Å. Co is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.72 Å) and two longer (1.81 Å) Co-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Co atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Co atom.
